content.snl: def-hyp(list-partial(Type.annotation(list-partial(@F, @G), Analysis.PFun), Type.annotation(@x, Real)), Analysis.higherInfinitesimal(F, G, x), Logic.and(Analysis.infinitesimal(F, x), Logic.and(Analysis.infinitesimal(G, x), Analysis.funLim(Div.div(F, G), @y, x, $0$))))

values.en: `F = o(G)` at `x₀` iff both are infinitesimals there and `F/G` tends to `0`; `F` vanishes strictly faster than `G`. This is the relation in which the Peano form of Taylor's remainder is stated: the remainder is `o((x − x₀)ᴺ)`.
values.zh-CN: `F = o(G)` 在 `x₀` 处成立，当且仅当二者在那里都是无穷小，且 `F/G` 趋于 `0`；即 `F` 比 `G` 消失得严格更快。泰勒余项的佩亚诺形式正是用此关系陈述的：余项为 `o((x − x₀)ᴺ)`。
